source.title: The Heart of Chromaggus
source.description: The heart of the once-fearsome Chromaggus rests in your hands. Its kaleidoscopic hues are as exquisite as they are grotesque. You sense a great power within the heart; something beyond your comprehension. To know more will require the aid of one much more powerful and ancient than yourself.
source.objective: Find someone who can understand the power of the Chromatic Heart.
source.progress: What have you brought me, little one?
source.completion: This heart is a terrible, aberrant, thing. However, its power could possibly be reformed to serve better ends.
